entries.title: LEGO® Fun
entries.description: Bring your creativity and imagination to build unique models using our LEGO® pieces. \nImportant: Children under 5 must be accompanied by their parents as small LEGO® pieces can be choking hazards.\nFor children and families.

entries.title: Kids' Writing Club: Letter to Santa
entries.description: Join us for a fun writing program and learn how to write a letter to Santa.

entries.title: Friday Family Game Zone
entries.description: C'mon over to our weekly Friday Family Game Zone.\nIn addition to board games and card games, we'll have ournbsp;Nintendo Switch hooked up for attendees to playnbsp;Mario Kart,nbsp;Super Smash Bros., Super Mario Party, and more.Free.

entries.title: Meet Santa: Books & Photos!
entries.description: A library staff member will be available to help take photos.Photos are limited to 2 minutes per family to ensure as many families as possible have an opportunity to meet Santa.The photo line closes promptly at 4:50 PM.

entries.title: Video Game Zone
entries.description: Have fun and compete with others in a variety of popular games on Nintendo Switch, including Mario Kart 8 Deluxe and Super Smash Bros.

entries.title: Cricut Open Lab
entries.description: You can also watch these tutorial videos ahead of time to get a better idea of how to use the Cricut machine and Design Space.nbsp;For those who already have experience using Cricut, they are welcome to register tonbsp;use a machine independently to cut out their designs.

entries.title: Friday Fun - Snow Globe Shaker
entries.description: Join us to make your own snow globe shaker.\nWe offer crafts, board games, bingo, and lots of fun for the whole familynbsp;every Friday.nbsp;\nFree.

entries.title: Friday Fun (Grab & Go): Decorating Wooden Gingerbread Houses
entries.description: This week, we will decorate festive wooden gingerbread houses to celebrate the winter holidays.nbsp;Recommended for ages 6 and up.

entries.title: Jewelry Making: STEM Craft
entries.description:
Join us for a creative jewelry making craft workshop.
Learn how to design and create your own unique bracelet using 
colorful beads and charms, andnbsp;take home your very own beaded 
bracelet.nbsp;Materials will be provided.nbsp;
Recommended for ages 7 and up.

entries.title: LEGO® Engineering Club
entries.description: Participate in a weeklynbsp;engineering challenge or make whatever you want!

entries.title: Reading to Children
entries.description: Children will enjoy one-on-one or small group interactions with our reading Volunteer.

entries.title: STEAM Club
entries.description: Each week,nbsp;participants will experience an exciting, new STEAM adventure involvingnbsp;hands-on activities that integrate different aspects of STEAM and showcase how STEAM concepts are appliednbsp;in the real worldnbsp;(a list of session topics may be found here).

entries.title: Winter Holiday Buttons
entries.description: Join us to create winter holiday buttons with the designs showed above!

entries.title: Explore Human Anatomy with AnatoKidz
entries.description: Learn about the brain, heart, lungs, bones, and more while building curiosity, confidence, and critical thinking skills.\nThis free, two-part series is recommended for children ages 5 to 10.

entries.title: Vietnamese Storytime & Craft-Kể chuyện và làm thủ công bằng tiếng Việt
entries.description: Children and their parents or caregivers will enjoy stories, songs, and playful activities in Vietnamesenbsp;that help build early language and literacy skills.Following thenbsp;Storytime, kids will learn to make a simple and creative craft to take home!

entries.title: Virtual Coding with Python
entries.description: Our trained teen volunteers will help students to learn about the basic principles behind computer science using the Python programming language.

entries.title: Friends of the Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Library Book Sale
entries.description: Come support your local library branch and find new literary treasures for yourself.

entries.title: Community Yoga & Meditation
entries.description: Learn basic Yoga routines, develop flexibility, relaxation and better health.\nNo registration needed.nbsp;Walk-ins are welcome.

entries.title: Friends of the Tully Branch Book Sale
entries.description: Come support your local library branch and find new treasures for yourself and your loved ones.

entries.title: Job Interview Coaching for Adults & Teens
entries.description: Meet one-on-one with Daniel, an experienced job interview coach to help you prepare by giving feedback on your resume and conducting a mock interview.

entries.title: Celebrating Filipino American History Month Storytime and Parol Lantern Making
entries.description: Join us for a captivating journey celebrating Filipino American History Month during our special storytime and Parol lantern making craft at the library. \nDelve into the rich tapestry of Filipino culture through engaging stories, vibrant music, and exciting activities that honor the traditions and contributions of Filipino Americans.

entries.title: Letters to the North Pole
entries.description: ✂️Festive Crafts:nbsp;Create a keepsake to brighten your holiday.

entries.title: Reading to Children
entries.description: This program is best suited for preschoolers and children in grades K-3 and will be held in the Reading to Children corner, within the Children's Area.\nFree.

entries.title: Bollywood Dance
entries.description: This family-friendly event is open to all ages.Get ready to move to the rhythm, learn some new dance moves, and immerse yourself in the energetic world of Bollywood.

entries.title: STEM Saturday: Robotics Adventure Workshop
entries.description: Discover the exciting world of robotics through hands-on learning and creative problem-solving.

entries.title: Volunteer Away Your Fines
entries.description:
Volunteer Away Your Fines at 20 per hour and earn community service hours while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment.nbsp;
Volunteers may be asked to assist with:
Cleaning materials, bookshelves, furniture, and computersChildren's toys cleanup
Details and Requirements:
Must be able to commit to the 60-minute sessionAnyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardianNo experience or special skills necessaryThe library will provide supplies
Space is limited.

entries.title: Reading to Children with Bria
entries.description: Participating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading and learning.

entries.title: Reading to Furry Friends
entries.description: \nChildren are invited to practice reading to gentle, trained assistance dogs who love books!

entries.title: Saturday STEM: MAD SCIENCE!
entries.description: Kids will explore a fun STEM activity focused on the theme of the day.nbsp;This week:nbsp;Wrestle with the strength of air and experiment with invisible forces that have incredible power.

entries.title: SaveNature: Insect Discovery Lab
entries.description: Join the Insect Discovery Lab for a wild experience featuring arthropods from around the world!

entries.title: Thread & Tea Society
entries.description: Come join our fiber craft society!

entries.title: Financial Literacy with Teens Who Invest
entries.description: Come learnnbsp;money matters with Teens Who Invest asnbsp;they present on how tonbsp;make good financial choices as teens andnbsp;adults.

entries.title: Fratello Marionettes: The North Pole Review
entries.description: Get into the holiday spirit withnbsp;Fratello Marionettes'nbsp;winter extravaganza, “The North Pole Review”.nbsp;This music-based production showcases our graceful ice skater Crystal Chandelier, the high-kicking antics of the Russian Trepak Dancers, and a trio of dazzling acrobatic penguins.

entries.title: Athena Project
entries.description: Through games, crafts, experiments, storytelling, role-play, and collaborative projects, participants will strengthen critical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and communication skills while exploring new ideas in a supportive and engaging environment.

entries.title: Everyone Can Code: Sphero Bolt Robot w/ Sphero EDU app
entries.description: Kids in Grades 4-8 will learn JavaScript coding and robotics with Sphero Bolt!

entries.title: Print it, Don't Just Think it: 3D Printing and TinkerCAD Workshop for Kids
entries.description: We will learn how to use TinkerCAD and how 3D printing works.

entries.title: Sunday Game Day
entries.description: We welcome children, teens, adults, andnbsp;families to play a variety of board games and card games at the Edenvale Branch Library, every first Sunday of the month.

entries.title: Fun with Micro:bit and MicroBlocks
entries.description: Students will use them together to learn how to make lights blink, create sound effects, utilize sensors, and write code to navigate a small programmable car.\nFree.

entries.title: Introduction to 3D Design Workshop
entries.description: Students will follow step-by-step guidance to create and personalize their own 3D keychain model using custom text, shapes, and patterns.
